channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: Trevor Lee’s controversial immigration bill stalls as some Republicans push back
item.description: An anti-immigration bill to strip public services from those in the state illegally has stalled in Utah's GOP-led Legislature.

item.title: Utah wants more control over federal lands. Here’s how lawmakers are advancing the fight.
item.description: From reducing Grand Staircase-Escalante and Bears Ears National Monuments to more logging in national forests, these bills and funding requests moving through the Utah Legislature show lawmakers’ priorities for asserting more control over millions of acres of federal land in the state.

item.title: Secretive ICE arrests in Salt Lake City courthouse have caught local authorities off guard
item.description: Federal immigration agents are making more arrests at a Salt Lake City courthouse without telling court security, Salt Lake County’s sheriff says.

item.title: Many Utah farmers don’t qualify for any of the $12B in help Trump admin rolled out. Here’s why.
item.description: Even if they get bridge funding, Utah farmers say rising costs and weak commodity prices still leave many barely breaking even. "For me personally," one said, "it’s going to be enough to cover my fuel bill."

item.title: State threatens to pull trendy Salt Lake City brunch spot’s liquor license over tax dispute
item.description: Sunday’s Best in Salt Lake City's Post District has until Friday to prove it has the ability to turn over sales tax money to the state.

item.title: I do… plan to change my tax filing status
item.description: If you’re married, you and your spouse typically have two options in the U.S. tax system: married filing jointly or married filing separately.

item.title: Trump’s DOJ sues Lt. Gov. Henderson, demanding she turn over Utahns’ private voter records
item.description: President Trump’s Justice Department sued Lt. Gov. Deidre Henderson and wants a court to order her to turn over Utahns' private voter data.

item.title: 2 men shot, injured at state liquor store in Taylorsville
item.description: Two men were injured in a Taylorsville liquor store shooting Thursday afternoon, including the suspected gunman, who was shot by a Utah Department of Public Safety officer, police said.

item.title: Newborn gorilla euthanized at Hogle Zoo after being injured during conflict
item.description: A newborn gorilla was euthanized hours after it was born at Hogle Zoo in Salt Lake City on Wednesday, zoo officials announced.

item.title: Here’s the latest on Utah Jazz star Lauri Markkanen’s injury — and what the NBA can do with his MRI
item.description: The Utah Jazz star's injury situation has caused some confusion about how the NBA investigates injuries. Here's the latest information on the situation.
